architecture: native historical M10 25-action joint preference policy; frozen P_train seed-1101 checkpoint

classification.auxiliary_training: world heads/losses are training concerns; H-005 runtime was frozen eval-only with world_updates=0
classification.candidate_wise_consequence: yes, native world outputs are action-conditioned and candidate rows enter candidate_actor logits
classification.global_latent_actor_residual: not used by this native H-005 joint path; do not substitute T-05 adapter evidence
classification.world_state_progression: yes, selected by_action hidden is carried to the next decision

non_actor_outputs: next_state is not in the17feature row; state vector critic does not take candidate rows; selected by_action hidden advances future recurrent state
public_provenance: native m10_environment._observation:796-864 constructs nodes from bridge.observe public view; graph relations use public positions, visibility, public mask and public task field. Event rows are received public records. Private assignment/lease/future schedule must not enter intervention or guard.
saved_evidence_limit: H-005 stores probabilities and selected hidden digests, but not candidate feature rows or per-component candidate logits; old rows cannot identify the world contribution numerically.

steps.direct_actor_use: features and pair_messages enter policy logits
candidate feature row is assembled for each of 25 actions
candidate_actor(candidate_features) is added directly to logits before masking
deterministic action is argmax of evaluation distribution
future decision state only; not a second same-step action score

training_limit: inference feature suppression cannot remove historical shared representation or auxiliary-loss training effects
